name: UCD Michael Smurfit Graduate Business School, University College Dublin

class_size.note: Class size not published on the programme page

tuition_total.note: Full-Time MBA tuition fee (EU and Non-EU) €39,640, payable in three instalments; non-refundable €2,000 deposit deducted from semester 1 fees; application fee €70

mandatory_fees_total.note: School's indicative 'MBA Travel (GNAM & Study Tours, Discretionary Spending; Visas)' line of €7,000 in the 12-month investment cost; partly discretionary. Textbooks €1,500 listed separately

living_budget_total.note: value = accommodation €13,600 + food/utilities €6,840 (on campus), excluding textbooks €1,500 and MBA travel €7,000. School's own indicative totals (fees + living + books + travel): €68,580 on campus, €75,520 off campus, 12 months

scholarship.note: Merit-based and need-based scholarships exist; no amounts or share of class published on the page read

base_salary.note: No employment report or graduate salary published by the school (searched school site and web, 2026-10-13). School cites only FT 2026: average salary growth of 100% after 3 years

employment.top_employers_note: 'Over the past few years' list; no hire counts

rankings_cited.note: School page: '#73 Financial Times Full-Time MBA Ranking 2026'; also 14th in the world for value for money

notes: No employment report: excluded from salary-based ROI unless one is published.
